column1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
# files components, computed: the locate mode and its toggle only with plocate or locate, the trash action only
# when trash-put or gio is installed (see lib/components.sh
# for the table format)
cat << 'ROWS'
mode  files  -  files under the directory         default
mode  dirs   -  directories under the directory   -
mode  grep   -  search file contents as you type  restart,nopersist
ROWS
if command -v rg > /dev/null; then
printf 'mode\treplace\t-\treplace a grep term'"'"'s matches (--term T): what you type is the replacement\thidden,nopersist\n'
fi
printf 'mode\targs\t-\tthe flags alt-a adds to fd or rg (--tool): what you type is the flags\thidden,nopersist\n'
if command -v plocate > /dev/null || command -v locate > /dev/null; then
printf 'mode\tlocate\t-\tpaths the locate database has under the directory, as you type\trestart,nopersist\n'
fi
cat << 'ROWS'
toggle  hidden   alt-h  hidden files and directories (dotfiles)            on
toggle  ignored  alt-i  files, dirs, grep, replace: files .gitignore and .ignore exclude                -
toggle  follow   alt-l  files, dirs, grep, replace: follow symbolic links into directories             -
toggle  multiline  alt-m  grep: matches may span lines (\n in the term; ripgrep only)  -
ROWS
if command -v plocate > /dev/null || command -v locate > /dev/null; then
printf 'toggle\teverywhere\talt-e\tlocate: every path the database has, not only those under the directory\t-\n'
fi
cat << 'ROWS'
sort  path    -  by path                                     default
sort  recent  -  newest first (modification time)            -
action  edit  ctrl-e  open in $EDITOR (grep: at the matching line)  foreground
action  apply  -  replace: the replacement into the selected matches (all when none are selected), asking first  foreground,asks,restart
action  undo   alt-u  grep, replace: put back the files the last replacement changed (unchanged since), asking first  foreground,asks,reload
ROWS
if command -v trash-put > /dev/null || command -v gio > /dev/null; then
printf 'action\ttrash\talt-x\tmove the selected files or directories to the trash (grep: the files of the matches)\tconfirm,reload\n'
fi
exit 0
